current_session: SELECT * FROM arp_agent_sessions WHERE agent_id=:agent_id AND state!='PURGED';
effective_policy: SELECT * FROM arp_context_policy_adoptions WHERE session_id=:session_id ORDER BY adoption_revision DESC LIMIT 1;
exact_context: SELECT * FROM arp_context_requests WHERE turn_id=:turn_id AND provider_request_ordinal=:ordinal;
active_index: SELECT * FROM arp_index_publications WHERE session_id=:session_id AND state='ACTIVE';
index_chunk_page: SELECT c.* FROM session_chunks c WHERE c.index_generation=:index_generation AND c.commit_seq<=:upper_commit AND c.rowid>:after_rowid ORDER BY c.rowid LIMIT :page_size;
index_vector_page: SELECT c.*,v.dim,v.vector_le_f32,v.embedding_receipt_ref_json FROM session_chunks c LEFT JOIN session_vectors v ON v.chunk_id=c.chunk_id AND v.index_generation=c.index_generation AND v.embedding_fingerprint=:embedding AND v.commit_seq<=:upper_commit WHERE c.index_generation=:index_generation AND c.commit_seq<=:upper_commit AND c.rowid>:after_rowid ORDER BY c.rowid LIMIT :page_size;
words_page: SELECT c.rowid,c.chunk_id FROM session_words JOIN session_chunks c ON c.rowid=session_words.rowid WHERE session_words MATCH :escaped_match AND c.index_generation=:index_generation AND c.commit_seq<=:upper_commit AND c.rowid>:after_rowid ORDER BY c.rowid LIMIT :page_size;
cursor_materialize: UPDATE cursor_pages SET state='MATERIALIZED',page_json=:page_json,page_hash=:page_hash,next_token_hash=:next_token_hash WHERE token_hash=:token_hash AND state='PENDING' AND expires_at_ms>:now;
query_progress: UPDATE search_queries SET after_rowid=:after_rowid,heap_json=:heap_json,elapsed_ms=:elapsed_ms,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE query_id=:query_id AND phase='SCANNING' AND row_version=:expected AND expires_at_ms>:now;
query_finalize: UPDATE search_queries SET phase='RESULTS',final_results_json=:results,elapsed_ms=:elapsed_ms,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE query_id=:query_id AND phase='SCANNING' AND row_version=:expected;
catalogue_exact: SELECT r.*,a.state,a.row_version,a.scope_ref_json FROM arp_catalog_revisions r JOIN arp_catalog_activation a USING(namespace_id,entry_kind,entry_id,revision,content_hash) WHERE r.namespace_id=:namespace AND r.entry_kind=:kind AND r.entry_id=:id AND r.revision=:revision AND r.content_hash=:hash;
claim_job: UPDATE arp_jobs SET state='LEASED',owner_id=:owner,lease_until_ms=:lease,row_version=row_version+1,attempts=attempts+1 WHERE job_id=:job_id AND state='PENDING' AND row_version=:expected AND next_at_ms<=:now AND deadline_ms>:now;
finish_job: UPDATE arp_jobs SET state='DONE',owner_id=NULL,lease_until_ms=NULL,row_version=row_version+1,result_receipt_ref_json=:receipt WHERE job_id=:job_id AND state='LEASED' AND owner_id=:owner AND row_version=:expected;
drain: UPDATE arp_agent_sessions SET state='DRAINING',generation=generation+1,row_version=row_version+1,destroy_command_id=:command,destroy_command_hash=:hash,purge_progress_json=:progress_json,purge_progress_hash=:progress_hash,updated_at_ms=:now WHERE session_id=:session AND state IN ('CREATING','ACTIVE','QUARANTINED') AND row_version=:expected;
begin_purge: UPDATE arp_agent_sessions SET state='PURGING',row_version=row_version+1,sealed_highwater=:highwater,delete_proof_ref_json=:proof,purge_progress_json=:progress_json,purge_progress_hash=:progress_hash,updated_at_ms=:now WHERE session_id=:session AND state='DRAINING' AND row_version=:expected;
finish_purge: UPDATE arp_agent_sessions SET state='PURGED',row_version=row_version+1,updated_at_ms=:now WHERE session_id=:session AND state='PURGING' AND row_version=:expected AND destroy_command_id=:destroy_command AND json_extract(purge_progress_json,'$.phase')='DELETE_CONFIRMED' AND json_type(purge_progress_json,'$.blocking')='null';
update_purge_progress: UPDATE arp_agent_sessions SET purge_progress_json=:progress_json,purge_progress_hash=:progress_hash,row_version=row_version+1,updated_at_ms=:now WHERE session_id=:session AND destroy_command_id=:destroy_command AND generation=:generation AND row_version=:expected AND state IN ('DRAINING','PURGING');
update_context_recall: UPDATE arp_context_recalls SET phase=:phase,progress_json=:progress,index_snapshot_ref_json=:snapshot,embedding_invocation_ref_json=:invocation,result_json=:result,result_hash=:result_hash,next_wake_at_ms=:wake,row_version=row_version+1 WHERE recall_key=:recall AND row_version=:expected AND phase IN ('PREPARING','WAITING_EMBEDDING','SCANNING','FETCHING_RESULTS');
context_recall_due: SELECT * FROM arp_context_recalls WHERE phase IN ('PREPARING','WAITING_EMBEDDING','SCANNING','FETCHING_RESULTS') AND next_wake_at_ms<=:now_ms ORDER BY next_wake_at_ms,recall_key LIMIT :limit;
purge_original_identity: SELECT * FROM arp_agent_sessions WHERE session_id=:session_id AND agent_id=:agent_id AND generation=:generation AND destroy_command_id=:destroy_command_id AND state IN ('DRAINING','PURGING');
